rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose spoken choice when “religious” means concerning religion.

example.english: This book is about religious matters.
example.traditional: 呢本書係同宗教有關嘅。

rows.note: Choose this for someone who sincerely practices or follows a religion, rather than merely discussing religion.

example.traditional: 我阿嫲拜佛拜得好虔誠。
example.jyutping: ngo5 aa3 maa4 baai3 fat6 baai3 dak1 hou2 kin4 sing4

rows.note: Choose this for intense, almost fanatical enthusiasm for a religion or another activity.

example.jyutping: keoi5 deoi3 zung1 gaau3 hou2 kong4 jit6
